name: Tarala
occupation: Herd Helper / Path Runner / Informal Scout
residence: Goshala Quarter — the cattle-keepers' district (but rarely stays in one place)
personality: emotionally open but not reflective yet
treats the world like it is meant to be explored
daily_routine: assisting Gopala with herd movement (often loosely)
wandering the forest edges near Satyapala's beat
helping Revati gather herbs when found
spending long periods unsupervised near paths or the old terrace ruins

goals.public_goal: Help family with herds and deliveries and be useful
goals.hidden_goal: Follow interesting paths and animals wherever they lead
goals.deep_goal: Understand why certain places feel 'different' without being able to explain it

beliefs: Animals choose paths better than people do
Some places feel like they are watching you
Stories sometimes describe real places even if no one admits it
Adults miss things because they stop looking closely
The settlement is bigger than what is officially used
